projection: same as slums.json: tile (col,row) top corner = ((col-row)*16, (col+row)*8)

groundKey.dirt: tiles/slums/tile-slums-dirt-N.png (pick a variant per tile, seeded by col,row)
groundKey.dirt-junk: tiles/slums/tile-slums-dirt-junk-N.png (pick a variant per tile, seeded by col,row)
groundKey.weeds: tiles/slums/tile-slums-weeds-N.png (pick a variant per tile, seeded by col,row)
groundKey.mud: tiles/slums/tile-slums-mud-N.png (pick a variant per tile, seeded by col,row)
groundKey.concrete: tiles/slums/tile-slums-concrete-N.png (pick a variant per tile, seeded by col,row)
groundKey.plate: tiles/slums/tile-slums-plate-N.png (pick a variant per tile, seeded by col,row)
groundKey.planks: tiles/slums/tile-slums-planks-N.png (pick a variant per tile, seeded by col,row)
groundKey.canal: tiles/slums/tile-slums-canal.png (4-frame strip, 3 fps, shared clock); bank overlays like the town water

heightNote: Ground level per tile: 0 = the maze floor, 1 = its junk walls (raised, blocked). No ramps.
wallsNote: Wall material for a raised tile's visible walls (tile-slums-cliff-<material>-l|r-N.png, variant seeded by col,row).
notes: The Scrap Warrens: built by scripts/build-warrens.ts from scripts/warrens/warrens-layout.json (the art folder's maps/warrens). Each run is its own copy; the shutters (dungeon.shutters, their passage tiles blocked here) open as each area's mini boss dies.
